_comment: The patient asked not to be called again. asked_to_stop ends the workflow for this patient immediately — no callback, no retry, no further checkpoint. The opt-out is handled in code rather than left to whoever reads the sheet next.
_matching: Replace REPLACE_WITH_call_id_FROM_SHEET with the value in the row's call_id column after placing a dry-run call. A result that cannot be matched to the call in flight is held for review rather than applied.
